nodes.label: Tailwind CSS Customization
nodes.rationale: Reference doc covering @theme directive, color/typography/spacing customization, custom utilities/variants, layer organization, @apply, plugins, and config.

nodes.label: Theme Directive (@theme)
nodes.rationale: Modern CSS-based Tailwind customization of colors (oklch), fonts, spacing, breakpoints, shadows, radius via @theme block.

nodes.label: Color Customization
nodes.rationale: Custom full color scales and semantic colors (success/warning/error/info) defined in oklch within @theme.

nodes.label: Typography Customization
nodes.rationale: Custom font stacks (sans/serif/mono/display) and font sizes (xs through jumbo) defined in @theme.

nodes.label: Custom Utilities (@utility)
nodes.rationale: Reusable utility classes created with @utility directive, e.g. content-auto, tab-*, glass glassmorphism effect.

nodes.label: Apply Directive (@apply)
nodes.rationale: Extract repeated utility patterns into component classes (e.g. .btn-primary, .input-field, .section-container) using @apply.

nodes.label: Plugins
nodes.rationale: Official plugins (@tailwindcss/typography, forms, container-queries) and custom tailwindcss/plugin with addUtilities/addComponents.

nodes.label: Content Configuration
nodes.rationale: Specify file globs to scan for classes and safelist dynamic classes/patterns to preserve them in the build.

nodes.label: Dark Mode Configuration
nodes.rationale: darkMode: ["class"] for class-based or "media" for automatic system preference; class-based uses <html class="dark">.
